nirf_name: Dr. B. R. Ambedkar University, Agra
description: Dr. Bhimrao Ambedkar University, Agra, formerly Agra University, was established on 1 July 1927 and has residential campuses in Agra including Paliwal Park, Khandari, Chhalesar and Bagh Farzana.

supports: The listing contains Dr. B. R. Ambedkar University, Agra in Agra, Uttar Pradesh.
The homepage identifies Dr Bhimrao Ambedkar University, Agra.
The university is formerly Agra University and was renamed Dr Bhimrao Ambedkar University, Agra.
The university lists four campuses, each in Agra.

agent_notes: The NIRF 2025 Overall government listing explicitly contains the assigned institution as Dr. B. R. Ambedkar University, Agra, Agra, Uttar Pradesh.
Normal TLS verification first failed with the managed proxy's exact self-signed certificate-chain error; public GETs then used curl --insecure only for expected public hosts.

The official site has a named Programs in the University page and a 2025-26 admissions brochure, but the sources are not a complete consistent catalogue: the brochure includes additional residential and affiliated offerings, the generic catalogue omits several current admission offerings, and the Ph.D. pages expose a flow-chart image and supervisor list rather than a complete named doctoral catalogue. Per outcome rules this is manual_review, not verified.
The course list includes named degree, diploma, certificate and generic doctoral offerings explicitly discoverable from official catalogue/admission pages; no doctoral specializations were invented.

Duration and eligibility were left null where the central official pages did not explicitly state them. Career mappings were reviewed against assets/data/career_path.db with read-only sqlite3 recursive breadcrumb queries; broad or absent disciplines use nearest-parent/closest-specialization mappings or mapping gaps.
